newsitem.title: HUNGARY: SOCCER-HUNGARY'S UJPEST SACK THEIR COACH.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-HUNGARY'S UJPEST SACK THEIR COACH.

text.p: Hungary's representatives in the UEFA Cup Ujpest dismissed their coach Laszlo Nagy on Tuesday after just four games of the season.

The decision follows a public row between Nagy and the club's main financial backer Sandor Solyom, who quit the club last week after the club's directors refused to back an earlier decison to sack Nagy.
"I stood by the coach and the team, but such a situation developed that we had to act," Ujpest president Bence Szabo said. "Nagy's statements to the press were dangerous to the club,"
Szabo said that following Nagy's departure Solyom had withdrawn his resignation.

He said assistant coach Peter Varhidi would take temporary charge of the team for the second-leg of the UEFA Cup preliminary tie against Aarhus in Denmark next Tuesday and that the club had approached former Hungarian international Laszlo Fazekas to take charge of the team from September.

Fazekas, is Hungary's second most capped player, having appeared 92 times for the national team. He was part of the successful Ujpest Dozsa side of the 1970's before moving to RFC Antwerp in Belgium, where he later worked as coach.
